name: Validation Tests
description: Schema validation tests for cross-SDK compatibility

testSuites.name: Extended Format Validators
testSuites.description: uri, hostname, datetime/date-time, credit-card, iban, bic/swift, routing, cusip, isin, lei, npi, dea, imei, iccid

testSuites.name: Validator Conformance
testSuites.description: Intersections, temporal bounds, percent, unions, pattern conditionals, field typeRefs, invariant null operands

testSuites.name: Conditional, Binary, and Decimal Conformance
testSuites.description: :if/:unless conditional requirement, :computed exclusion, binary byte-length bounds, decimal place enforcement

testSuites.name: Schema Definition Enforcement
testSuites.description: Invariant evaluation, currency/percent bounds, override restrictiveness, intersection conflicts, tabular columns, default-value rules

testSuites.name: Array-of-Type Required Enforcement
testSuites.description: Required markers on array-of-object entry fields inside a reusable type (reference and inline forms), enforced per present element
